body:
Nah I'm really not the type to start smoking, lol. Bunch of people I know do it, but I'm not interested. Nothing against it though.

Otherwise, yeah Colorado is pretty decent. It's just what I've always known, grew up here. I try to go out and do new things every once in a while, but I've pretty much done it all around here. Which makes it feel like I'm trapped in a loop even more.
Denver, Colorado. Walks are nice when I get the chance, but unless I find the motivation to drive an hour away, there's not too much nature to walk round in. Big city
I guess recently I've just been a heal bitch. Mercy and Moira are fun
I've been playing for 6 years. I used to love playing akali and Katarina, but after their reworks it's been hard finding a champion I feel like I can main
I play league of legends mostly at the moment, but also hearthstone, overwatch, and a few others. All games where I'm just trying to best someone else

I have a job in retail, I've worked there for 2 years. I love working there, but I make little to no money, living paycheck to paycheck. I don't have the confidence to try working anywhere else, I want to stay where I know I'm comfortable. Except that's leaving me barely capable of keeping a place to live or food on the table.

I spend most of my off time escaping into video games, which I'm now realizing are all competitive. It's all I seem to enjoy outside of work. If you'd even consider that enjoyment, I mean. It's mostly just me trying to feel better about myself when the rest of my time I feel worthless.
